name: Iminify API
description: Everything the Iminify website does with images, over HTTP. Every request carries a personal access token from Settings > API Tokens as a Bearer token, for an account whose email is verified. Compressions and page scans run in the background: create one, then poll it until it has finished. The guides are at https://www.iminify.com/docs.
